types.definition: The spread and shape of a quantity sampled over an ensemble (configurations, sites, local environments, specimens, particles) read as the result: range, central value, width, tails, multimodality, or overlap of two such distributions. Quantity and ensemble in attrs. Not for imaged-feature statistics (OBS/morphology/feature_metric) or peaks of orientation/misorientation distributions (OBS/signal)
types.why_not_existing: characteristic_value reads one defined point of a curve; trend reads change with a controlled variable; feature_metric is restricted to imaged features; OBS/signal reads discrete peaks. In disordered-solid papers the claim IS the spread: 'E_f spans 1.49 eV' leads to local-environment attribution and to overlap arguments between two spectra (vacancy vs interstitial migration -> recombination), which a single value cannot license. The same next step follows Weibull strength scatter (reliability), nanoindentation hardness histograms (phase heterogeneity), DLS size distributions and site-energy distributions in catalysis/amorphous alloys
types.fallback: OBS/response/characteristic_value with attrs.statistic = range|mean|spread, fit poor

mm_ops.name: read_distribution_statistics
mm_ops.definition: Read range, central value, width, tails, per-class shift or overlap from a histogram or distribution of a non-imaged quantity over an ensemble (computed configurations, test specimens, sites)
mm_ops.why_not_existing: measure_feature_metric covers histograms only of image-derived values (r02 ruling #23); read_characteristic_point reads one point of a curve; compare_coplotted_quantities judges dominance on shared axes, not the width of an ensemble. Failure modes are specific: small sample per class (F6/F7 have 1-3 counts per dumbbell type), bin choice, colour-coded classes that cannot be told apart

mm_ops.name: read_orientation_relationship
mm_ops.definition: From a superposed (measured SAED/FFT or simulated) pattern of two phases, or pole figures of both, read which planes and directions are parallel and the misfit between them (orientation relationship, habit plane) to argue coherency, epitaxy or nucleant potency
mm_ops.why_not_existing: assign_features maps reflections to phases and leads to STR/phase/identity; match_to_reference judges whole-pattern coincidence with a reference. Reading an OR leads instead to STR/interface (coherency, epitaxy, nucleation potency). The case recurs in precipitation-hardened alloys, grain-refiner papers, epitaxial films (film/substrate OR from SAED or phi scans) and heterogeneous nucleation studies

comments: 1) Only one new leaf, and it is an OBS leaf driven by one computation paper; the evidence for generality is argued (Weibull, nanoindentation, DLS), so I also give a fallback. If only one of the pair is accepted, keep the mm_op read_distribution_statistics: the figure act is clearly new, while the type could live as characteristic_value + attrs.statistic. 2) Precipitate/second-phase leaf (judge's candidate): three of my four papers are about second phases (WSi2/ZrC/nano-SiC, Al2Ca, M23C6/MX). All typed cleanly with phase/identity (which), phase/fraction (dissolved vs surviving), feature_size (coarsening, refinement), distribution (where) and STR/interface (OR with matrix). I argue AGAINST a precipitate leaf: each aspect has a different next inference, and a combined leaf would hide which one the argument uses. 3) Boundary conflict: 'extrusion' appears in both PRC/forming and PRC/treatment (deformation processing). Proposed rule: forming turns feedstock (powder, melt, pellets) into a body; thermomechanical working of an already-made solid body (hot extrusion of a cast billet, rolling, forging, ECAP) is treatment. JMA j7 is typed treatment, fit poor, until this is written into both definitions. 4) Reactive hot pressing/SPS and SHS-consolidation do synthesis and forming in one act. Ceramics c6 is typed PRC/synthesis by the precursor rule, with attrs.concurrent_forming=true, fit poor. Proposed rule: type as synthesis, and put densification in attrs; do not split one act into two nodes. 5) Proxy claims: KAM/GAM -> 'degree of martensitic transformation' (Matchar m17) is typed STR/phase/fraction with attrs.proxy. Worth one line in the basis note: evidence through a proxy is still 'evidenced', but the proxy should be named. 6) A property map over sample space (Matchar F8 hardness surface) is spatial_map, but it is read as a trend against distance, and the op that assigns values to weld zones is register_colocated_views (F8b indents on the etched section). I would add to modality_notes: 'property maps (hardness, modulus, conductivity) -> spatial_map'. 7) Audits found (image vs text): JMA F1 rod width 322.61 um contradicts the ~20-40 um visible at a 100 um bar (j15); JMST F8 'especially V and Cr' is not visible (h18 partial); JMST F4 'rises with V' is not visible (h16 partial); Matchar F12a CGHAZ shows the densest M23C6 indexing where M23C6 should have dissolved (m22), and F8 shows no as-welded soft zone at the Type IV site (m25).
